arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS prepaid_debit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made on cards whose type is prepaid debit, across the whole data period.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' means card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' exactly, not plain 'Debit'.
Counts every transaction regardless of fraud label or error status, covering 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
